nodes.label: SKIP LOCKED for Non-Blocking Queue Processing
nodes.source_location: ## Use SKIP LOCKED for Non-Blocking Queue Processing
nodes.rationale: Without SKIP LOCKED, a second worker doing SELECT ... FOR UPDATE blocks on the first worker's lock, serializing the queue. Skipping already-locked rows lets each worker claim a different job, claimed as ~10x throughput for worker queues.

nodes.label: Atomic Claim-and-Update Queue Pattern
nodes.rationale: Folding the SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED into the UPDATE's subquery makes claiming a job a single statement, so no window exists between selecting and marking a job as processing.
